crossRefs.note: Yet you say, “The way of the Lord is not fair.” House of Israel, I will judge every one of you after his ways.’ ”
“Yet you say, ‘The way of the Lord is not equal.’ Hear now, house of Israel: Is my way not equal? Aren’t your ways…
Yet the house of Israel says, ‘The way of the Lord is not fair.’ House of Israel, aren’t my ways fair? Aren’t your ways…
“Do you think this to be your right, or do you say, ‘My righteousness is more than God’s,’
Will you even annul my judgment? Will you condemn me, that you may be justified?
“He also who had received the one talent came and said, ‘Lord, I knew you that you are a hard man, reaping where you…
for I feared you, because you are an exacting man. You take up that which you didn’t lay down, and reap that which you…
“He said to him, ‘Out of your own mouth I will judge you, you wicked servant! You knew that I am an exacting man…

translations.web: “ ‘Yet the children of your people say, “The way of the Lord is not fair;” but as for them, their way is not fair.
translations.bsb: Yet your people say, ‘The way of the Lord is not just.’ But it is their way that is not just.
translations.kjv: Yet the children of thy people say, The way of the Lord is not equal: but as for them, their way is not equal.
translations.asv: Yet the children of thy people say, The way of the Lord is not equal: but as for them, their way is not equal.
